verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents continuous daily monitoring with alerts for failing tests, and admins get proactive email notifications when tests need attention. It also offers auto-generated infrastructure-as-code fixes and a centralized Notifications Hub for acting on findings. Slack/Jira notifications and ticket sync are documented only for vendor-risk and access-review workflows, not for failing control tests. Missing for 10: Slack or ticketing routing of control-test failures, explicit configuration-drift alerting, evidence that the alerts themselves carry remediation context, independent or hands-on corroboration.
